decisions.reason: Reopened S01: he says "My grandmother's Australian Indigenous and also Afghan. The name comes from my great-grandfather, who was an Afghan cameleer." The win is now presented as one reported reaction that "shows little on its own", with the joy with his sister beside it. Body and metadata match.

The passage now says he gave his reason ("I do have to talk about it") and that most later openness came in promotional interviews. It names the narrower open tension: how much he volunteers beyond the job, weighed against his stated wish for privacy.

The Type 3 section quotes Lind's "You'll get it, because you're you" framing, uses "shared the shortlist in confidence" instead of secrecy, and limits the private-call setting to the behaviour she reports. The line is identified as her verdict to People, placed directly under the heading's section opening.
Reworded as the author's open question. The article gives Grace's IT: Welcome to Derry prompt, says he was admiring a craft quality, and no longer says he described freedom as closed to himself.

Corrected: "The two remarks were published about eight months apart, in July 2025 and March 2026." C15 and new C99 record the dates.

The hook now quotes his continuation ("Then the announcement came out a day after...") instead of calling "Yes" one word. "More scared" appears only as Fanning's question. The persona title, meta title and description no longer state it as fact, and the win is demoted to supporting evidence. The franchise-premise limit sits beside the told-as-a-joke caveat. The article dates the conversation to the early-2024 shoot, keeps February 13, 2025 as publication, and names the set visit as the exception in the limit paragraph. Fixed with subject-F1: his own Indigenous and Afghan heritage statement is quoted, the Wikipedia sentence presents compatibility, and the interpretation offers identity ("claims that heritage publicly"), practicality and company side by side. Only the mosque line is attribution-flagged.

The East of Eden case is described as an instruction he followed after planning to watch the film "maybe after I got the role", with no approval afterward and his last-two-episodes aside. The sequence claim is limited to Harrelson ("The Harrelson case has a clear order"). "Complied without argument" was removed, and C22 and new C95 updated.

Interval corrected. The HERO quote is framed with Grace making him come to dinner with her mother ("The family was Grace's, assembled on location"). The Halifax line is introduced as his answer to McGregor's favourite-memory question. The paragraph claims only that company works as a steadying force, not "protection from his own thoughts".

The Hal identification is sourced to Flaunt (S04), with Hal's US series background from S24 (C89), presented as background with no causal claim. Bilched is described as a comedy Hal wrote and cast with his younger brothers and friends (C79).

Option (b). The win is demoted to supporting evidence in both alternative sections: "The win itself does not settle this. A huge new obligation disrupts a Nine too, and that morning also brought joy with his sister." The anti-Three clause "fear of falling short more than a need for validation" was removed. The discriminator now rests on what settles his nerves, stated in the type section. The sister celebration is acknowledged in the hook.

The article now says the quote does not favour a type ("belongs to Threes as much as Sixes, and to most newcomers"), and the "precision separates it from newcomer humility" claim was removed. The Three section adds that this fear "sits comfortably in Three territory". Separation is located in dated remedy statements about reliability (Close "always there for me", "confident... in the people around me", Pugh "makes everyone feel so comfortable").

No Zada statement credits Jacobson, so the credit-routing argument was removed entirely, including from the evidence alternative_case. The Three section now acknowledges self-crediting ("I can go toe to toe with anyone now") and calls the hedging "a tendency, not a rule".

At the passage the article now leads with skill ("a director father and an actor brother were the best crew for a properly shot and edited tape"). It notes the relational phrasing only as consistent with the Six reading, and limits its weight. "Harder on purpose" was replaced with his stated reason and the fact that he was still shooting.

The teenage sessions are recast as habit ("the auditions were his brother's. The habit is what matters"). The threshold claim now counts "two clear cases of family around his own threshold" (flight home, Berlin), and the Berlin trip carries the pay-cheque alternative.

"Good news keeps arriving" was removed. The East of Eden no-pressure line is acknowledged as cutting the other way ("a famous role that produced no pressure until the work was done"). The sequence is claimed only for Harrelson, with East of Eden described as an imposed instruction.

The aggregate is lowered to "consistent with a Six reading rather than a demonstration of it", and two items press style does not explain are named: the flight home and the recurring fear. The remaining concession pairs are the pay-cheque trip and the swearing caveat.

The Nine rebuttal now uses self-assertion: his own three-week deadline, begging the sound department to allow music (HERO, 2026) and the planned move abroad despite his mother's preference (Interview, 2026).

The interval is corrected to about eight months, with both publication dates, and C15 is corrected. "Across years" is kept: with the early-2024 set interview correctly dated (fan-02), the record runs from early 2024 to June 2026, and the limit paragraph states that span explicitly. The HERO dinner context is added.

The article now says the call supplied only the behaviour (shortlist in confidence, naming contenders) and that "He just gets what he wants" was Lind's verdict in the People interview. The hook no longer runs the FaceTime into the quote, and C26 is corrected.

Fixed with critic-10. The hook no longer quotes Lind. The Type 3 section separates what she reports from the private call from her verdict to People, and C26's inference matches. The Type 3 argument is weighted as "an affectionate prediction from a friend, given to the press".

The hook quotes "Yes" followed by his continuation to the announcement, and the opening uses "so I more or less knew immediately". All quotations in the first two paragraphs were re-verified against S01.

The section's first sentence is neutral. The Type 3 section no longer uses the school exit, the "shares a structure with what comes later" sentence was removed, and the section was shortened.
The description now refers to the Hunger Games role and to steadying himself with trusted people, without "peers" (131 characters, consistent with the FAQs).

The Nine section and the new discriminator cite dated remedy passages: July 2025 "once I step on set and meet everyone", June 2025 relayed "feel comfortable", July 2026 Close "always there for me", June 2026 Pugh "makes everyone feel so comfortable". "Getting inside the circle" was rewritten as "What settles him", and the acceptance paragraph was removed. The type section states: "It is thin on other Six markers, such as testing whether people can be trusted or ambivalence toward authority, which keeps confidence at medium." The opening no longer asserts intent. The audition passage says "He was still shooting" before he asked for three weeks and quotes his stated plan to shoot and edit properly.
The pattern is stated as two clear instances (Haymitch tape, Berlin), and the teenage sessions appear only as the formative habit of preparing with a partner.

Corrected to "about eight months apart, in July 2025 and March 2026", and C15 corrected. No other passage overstates the span.
